title: [Run] Result outdated on relaunch
author: davidegiacometti
summary: When PowerToys Run preserves the previous query, reopening it can display stale plugin results such as an outdated Windows service state.
next_action: Reproduce on current Run and compare cached result reuse with a forced query refresh on reopen.

confidence.rationale: The host behavior matches the symptom, but plugin-versus-host ownership needs a trace.

judgment.rationale: The issue gives a deterministic service-state control and current MainViewModel.ToggleWox only shows the existing window when ClearInputOnLaunch is false, without an obvious forced requery in that branch.
evidence: Search for a service, change its state externally, then reopen Run with clear-previous-query disabled.
The displayed service status remains stale.
A 2022 commenter confirmed the behavior on 0.63.
Current ToggleWox preserves the query and makes the window visible when ClearInputOnLaunch is false.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on current Run and compare cached result reuse with a forced query refresh on reopen.

fix_assessment.rationale: The stale presentation is source-plausible, but a lightweight pass did not establish whether refresh belongs in the host or in dynamic-state plugins.

issue_context.summary: When PowerToys Run preserves the previous query, reopening it can display stale plugin results such as an outdated Windows service state.
known_information: The Service plugin is a reliable example because service state can change while Run is hidden.
Clearing the query avoids reusing the old visible result.
inferences: The host may be reusing the previous result collection without asking plugins to refresh, but plugin-level caching remains an alternative.
issue_context.analysis: A simple current reproduction with query instrumentation can choose the proper ownership boundary.
initial_investigation: Inspected PowerLauncher MainViewModel.ToggleWox and ClearInputOnLaunch handling.
Confirmed the show-with-preserved-query branch does not visibly clear or rerun from the inspected code.

actions.label: Reproduce stale preserved Run query
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Change service state while PowerToys Run is hidden
prerequisites: Clear the previous query on launch disabled
A test Windows service whose state can be changed
setup: Open Run and search for the service.
Leave the query and result visible, then hide Run.
steps: Change the service state outside Run.
Reopen Run without editing the query.
Record whether the displayed state refreshes.
Type and remove one character to force a query and compare the result.
reproduce.expected_result: Reopening Run with a preserved query should refresh dynamic plugin state rather than display the old result.
